What shortwave stations can I hear in the UK?

Tonight's best bets in the UK include China Radio International on 9600 kHz, Voice of Vietnam on 9730 kHz, AIR Akashvani Ext.Service on 9620 kHz. Stations beamed at Europe are the easiest catches; the tables on this page are rebuilt daily from the published schedule.

What time is best for shortwave listening in the UK?

Evening and night are best for distant stations. From the UK the 49, 41 and 31 metre bands (about 6, 7 and 9.5 MHz) are busiest in the evening, and 19 and 16 metres (15 and 17 MHz) during the day.

Are there English shortwave broadcasts to the UK?

Yes. 23 stations broadcast in English toward Europe this season, including World Music Radio, RealMix Radio, China Radio International, Brother Stair.

How do I convert shortwave UTC times to UK time?

Shortwave schedules use UTC. UK is currently on GMT, which is UTC+0. This page already shows times in local time.

Can I listen without a shortwave radio?

Yes. Free WebSDR and KiwiSDR receivers let you tune real shortwave receivers in your browser. See the Listen Online page.
